arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Sutton argued Congress did not divest states of their traditional delegation authority.
Cordray argued federal law preempts local licensing schemes for property carriers.
Stewart argued the phrase safety regulatory authority naturally encompasses delegation powers.
Rehnquist asked Sutton to answer a factual question during the argument.
